results.check: Desktop board renders seeded 3/5 objectives and five inventory items
Completion writes a save and a fresh rendered page restores it (storage adapter)
Main quest completes; undo reverses its count, reward, and inventory
Untrusted objective text is escaped; impossible closure applies no penalty
Independent player, new dungeon, objective creation, and edit controls work
Practice reward, daily cap, and recovery-mode controls work
Decay simulator previews level loss and return without changing the save
Module preview, installation, and duplicate-install rejection work
ChatGPT patches require approval; handoffs exclude other players
JSON backup download and explicit full-state restore work
Fictional call answers; driving mode makes the game board inert
390px touch layout: all four screens and the handoff dialog fit without horizontal overflow
Unavailable storage uses working session mode and clearly requests a backup
An unreadable save is preserved instead of being silently overwritten
No uncaught JavaScript errors across the rendered interaction checks

scope: Unmodified app rendered inline in Chromium. 1440px desktop and 390px touch viewport. Storage adapter used for save/restore flow.
not_tested: Real localStorage persistence across browser restarts
environment_limitation: Installed browser blocks localhost and file URL navigation with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR. No restrictions were changed.
